metadata.title: बिहार की तर्ज पर 'SIR' त्रिपुरा में लागू करने की मांग | Tipra Motha demands SIR for Tripura
metadata.description:
A high-level delegation of Tripura's tribal leaders, led by Tipra Motha founder and royal scion Pradyot Kishore Manikya, met Election Commission of India (ECI) officials in New Delhi today. The delegation strongly demanded that illegal migrants from Bangladesh must not be included in Tripura's electoral rolls. They also reiterated their long-standing demand for the implementation of the Scheduled Tribe Indigenous Reservation (SIR) in the state.

Main Bhi Bharat's Executive Editor, Chitrita Sanyal, spoke exclusively with the delegation members to understand their concerns and the political and demographic implications of their demands.

Watch this important conversation that highlights the voices of Tripura’s indigenous communities and their ongoing struggle to protect their identity and political rights.
